Class FreezeManagerTest

java.lang.Object
com.tetris.gameLogic.FreezeManagerTest
class FreezeManagerTest extends Object
Unit tests for the FreezeManager class. Tests freeze activation, one-time use restriction, duration, and reset functionality. Note: Requires JavaFX Platform initialization since FreezeManager uses Timeline.
Author:
Jacob Villegas
